surface: Google AI Overview and AI Mode
method: Every source behind each captured Google AI answer was listed, then counted for repeated domains within a single answer.
finding: No domain appeared twice in any single answer. AI answers gather one best page per sub-question rather than several pages from one strong domain, which is the opposite of a ranked results page.
caveat: Small sample, one question set, one window. We cannot tell from the outside whether one-per-domain is Google selecting one page per domain or deduplicating what it displays. For a vendor deciding where to invest the consequence is identical either way.
